from pocket_coffea.parameters.cuts import Cuts
from pocket_coffea.lib.categorization import MultiCut, CartesianCut

# Define jet multiplicity binning (multi-bin cut wrapper)
jet_multiplicity = MultiCut(
    name="jet_multiplicity",
    cuts=[
        ("4j", Cuts.njets == 4),
        ("5j", Cuts.njets == 5),
        ("6+j", Cuts.njets >= 6),
    ]
)

# Define b-tag multiplicity binning (multi-bin cut wrapper)
btag_multiplicity = MultiCut(
    name="btag_multiplicity",
    cuts=[
        ("2b", Cuts.nbjets == 2),
        ("3+b", Cuts.nbjets >= 3),
    ]
)

# Create cartesian product of binnings (cartesian combination container)
analysis_categories = CartesianCut(
    binnings=[jet_multiplicity, btag_multiplicity]
)

# Resulting categories: 4j_2b, 4j_3+b, 5j_2b, 5j_3+b, 6+j_2b, 6+j_3+b
if __name__ == "__main__":
    for category in analysis_categories:
        print(f"Category: {category.name}")
        print(f"  Cuts: {category.cuts}")
